description: Source code for the ArrowSerializer class in Apache Spark, used for converting user objects into Arrow batches for serialization and IPC stream creation.

classes.name: ArrowSerializer
classes.description: Helper class for converting user objects into Arrow batches, supporting serialization, appending records, writing IPC streams, and managing resources.

classes.name: ArrowSerializer.Serializer
classes.description: Abstract base class for serializing individual fields or structures into Arrow vectors.

classes.name: ArrowSerializer.FieldSerializer
classes.description: Serializes a specific field type into an Arrow vector, with methods to set values.

classes.name: ArrowSerializer.ArraySerializer
classes.description: Serializes array-like data into a ListVector.

classes.name: ArrowSerializer.StructFieldSerializer
classes.description: Serializes individual fields within a StructVector.

classes.name: ArrowSerializer.StructSerializer
classes.description: Serializes entire StructVectors with multiple fields.

methods.name: sizeInBytes
methods.description: Returns the size of the current batch in bytes, including schema and buffers.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a record to the current batch.

methods.name: writeIpcStream
methods.description: Writes the schema and current batch as an Arrow IPC stream to an OutputStream.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the serializer to start a new batch.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the serializer and releases resources.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Checks if the serializer has been closed.
